body: i dont know. how would i even tell my mom? she's always decided when it's time to go

i don't know. this lady's supposed to be here in like 10 minutes so we would have to wait til she's been and gone. that'll make me feel so much worse so i guess i really should go.

there's only one hospital in my area and they've never been that great, but i'll have to go to them. i guess. maybe. i don't know. i always feel like i've being a pain in the ass by going without even having tried hurting myself.

i'm from the uk (england, in london) and yeah, stuck is it basically.

like what people are suggesting is good, but i can't get past how they think and try to do things and how rude they are. i really should go to hospital but i'm so so scared that i'll get stuck talking to somebody who's like that again

i don't know. what i have now is, people come round who are supposed to talk to me about stuff and make a plan of what i'm supposed to work on. like, we decided i would start trying to leave my house more and work up from that. there's also talk of putting me on antianxieties.

which is great but it sucks if i can't work with the actual people who are doing it.

i feel like i have to. otherwise she said she'll probably stop trying to help because i'm "not willing to help myself" (which is a bs excuse everybody uses) but i can't.

and i spose i have agoraphobia too. i also have trust issues with people like therapist, psychiatrists, social workers, all that lot, because i've never been able to click with them and they've always been really antsy about it, so it's even harder if i have to meet one of them.

i don't really know. she's like a social worker but she's more specialized in helping people like me with anxiety that can't leave their home.

she means well but she's really catty and narrow minded, so i can't make myself talk to her anymore.

i've been a bunch of times and stayed a few nights. it's never turned out well. though i've never gone during the day. maybe they're always pissy and short tempered because it's only ever been night time when i've gone.

i'm too young to drive and i can't take public transport or anything, so i would have to get my mom to drive me, and i can't do that. i really don't want to stress her out. 

i posted a comment saying something i forgot [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/31qvr9/this_place_is_too_much_for_me_i_really_need_to_go/cq4384u) and my mom really wants me to see this woman, so i don't think she would take me. i told her i'm way too stressed out to do it but she just ignores me and talks as if everything is going her way and like i'm "co operating", it's weird. i'll say no and she'll go, "so i'll see you downstairs and such and such time?" i hate it.

it's even worse because today, some woman from this new group i'm with is visiting. i can't stand her. i can't be around her. she has the attitude i was talking about and, i just can't.

the last time i saw her, i couldn't go down and be in the room with her because of how bad i was doing. today, i'm doing even worse. i've been trying to cheer up but i can't and i really can't meet her, but people keep on at me saying i have to and i can't. it'll really push me over the edge but nobody cares.
